jobs.title: Senior Recruiter (NYC)

postalAddress.streetAddress: 7 World Trade Center, 39th Floor, New York NY

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

Where you'll create impact

  • Build and execute DualEntry’s recruiting strategy across GTM, Operations, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Leadership roles

  • Partner with founders and hiring managers on role definition, target profiles, and market positioning

  • Source and close exceptional candidates in competitive markets using creative, non-obvious sourcing strategies

  • Own the candidate experience, employer brand, and hiring process end to end

  • Build pipeline reporting and analytics to know what’s working

     

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting at high-growth startups, ideally building a function from scratch (ATS, candidate experience systems, process)

  • Deep sourcing expertise - you find talent beyond inbound

  • Analytical: you track what's working and manage against KPIs

 

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the TA Team

  • Shweta was DualEntry's first Talent hire before there was a team, an ATS, or a process, there was just her building it from zero. Ex-Meta recruiter, agency founder and the reason the TA team below moves as fast as it does.

  • Nikolija conducted an interview process in 24h - from LinkedIn outreach, through prescreen and team interviews to on-site case presentation and offer - all in one day.

  • Polina joined as a 2nd TA hire and built the product and design team 0 > 1, with the fastest hire closed in just 6 days.

  • Magdalena joined as Founding TA, setting up ATS, KPIs and sourcing processes and leading the Engineering hiring function. Closed multiple strategic hires across the business, setting the fastest time-to-hire record: 4 days

  • Valentina an Ashby ghostbuster who built the reporting and dashboard stack from scratch, filled a historically hard-to-fill partnerships role within her first month with 9 days time to hire.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $40,000 - $65,000

  • Base salary: $130,000 - $200,000

  • Variable compensation: $15,000 - $60,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

“The biggest problems are solved by people willing to take on what others think is impossible. At DualEntry, you’ll work with exceptional builders. Join us at the moment where everything is still being written. You’ll have the chance to build, influence our direction and see your impact every day.”

Shweta Sharma, Head of Talent at DualEntry

  • Deep experience with Figma and scalable design systems

  • Strong UX thinking, interaction design, and attention to visual detail

  • Comfort working with HTML/CSS/JavaScript

  • Ability to make fast, pragmatic decisions

  • Bonus if you have experience designing fintech, accounting, or enterprise SaaS tools

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

Andy kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, helping accounting professionals learn about in-production AI-native workflows.

  • Bram Founding Product Designer, designed DualEntry's AI agent end to end and built the core of the product's design system.

  • Sudarshan went from new hire to presenting design direction to the entire company within 2 weeks of joining.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s, with no new entrants in 30 years. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers. We're looking for people with a track record of accomplishing difficult things, whether through their careers or achievements outside of work. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community - because that's what it takes to reinvent a $220B industry.

Why This Role Matters Now

📍 Location: New York City HQ, 7 World Trade Center

Where you’ll create impact

  • Drive cross-functional execution on the Founders' highest-priority initiatives across Product, Engineering, GTM, Brand, and Partnerships. Own outcomes end-to-end.

  • Prepare the Founders for every high-stakes moment - enterprise sales calls, investor pitches, board meetings, keynotes. Be his stand-in when needed.

  • Collaborate with Founders and other executive leaders to define long-term strategic goals and develop clear operational plans to achieve them

  • Proactively resolve problems, and deal with issues before they escalate to the Founders

  • Work with teams to improve our best practices, lean process flow, and patterns of behavior

  • Build frameworks for evaluating new opportunities. Analyze data to clarify what matters.

  • Own the narrative from the CEO's office. Write content, shape communications, and help the founding team tell the story internally and externally.

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 4+ years in consulting, operations, strategy, or product at a high-growth tech company

  • Highly organized; loves structure, process, and follow-through

  • High agency, takes ideas from 0 → 1 without handholding

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills

  • Operational & analytical rigor to build financial models and charisma to stand in for the CEO

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Thrives in high-growth, fast-changing environments

  • Low ego, high ownership; does what's needed

  • Fast executor

  • Strong business instincts; understands products, markets, and technical concepts

  • Seamlessly switch altitudes from strategy to execution

  • Positive, inspiring influence on every team

  • Excited to work in-office 5 days/week

Nice To Have

  • Entrepreneurial experience or at an earlier stage high growth technology company

  • Demonstrated interest in accounting and ERP

  • Experience working with Product or Engineering teams on sprint planning

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the Team

  • Max owns the automation and productization of our GTM motion. In his first quarter, he created a systems for customers to "try before they buy" - leading to a 2x+ boost in win-rate, as well as spinning up dozens of bots and agents to build cross-functional efficiency.

  • Woosung leads finance at DualEntry and would work closely with the Chief of Staff to keep company-wide priorities on track.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $120,000 - $175,000

  • Significant Equity

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k)

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

This role sits at the center of everything, driving DualEntry’s highest-priority company initiatives. If you want a front-row seat to how a company actually gets built, this is it.

Woosung Chun, CFO

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Design backend systems and APIs (Python preferred) that run real-time, business-critical accounting logic

  • Ship features end to end - architecture, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and beyond

  • Integrate third-party tools and external systems, proactively managing edge cases and risk

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years in backend engineering (language agnostic)

  • Deep experience with complex business logic products

  • Strong database skills: PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, schema design

  • Experience deploying on AWS (or similar), with solid CI/CD and production-readiness fundamentals

  • Bonus: Python and a modern web framework (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the Engineering Team

  • Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

  • Marcin took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest.

  • Puhiza grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework end to end; scaling it to support migrations, integrations, and bank connections. The queen of I/O on our platform.

  • Danylo took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend.

     

How You Operate

  • Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability - we use Postgres until it breaks

  • Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three' - Jeff Bezos.

  • Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

  • Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission

     

Benefits & Compensation

  • Equity: $50,000 - $80,000

  • Base salary: $140,000 - $250,000

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

  • Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

  • Unlimited AI token usage

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

  • In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

 

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca, Head of Engineering at DualEntry

About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

  • Own e2e account management outcomes: Manage key customer relationships, run success plans, and lead recurring check-ins, based on customer tiers you’ve developed

  • Be the ultimate escalation point: Resolve critical issues for high-tier accounts post-go-live

  • Operationalize customer support: Create and continuously improve SOPs, best practices, support documentation center, and overall support processes, while handling support for your owned accounts

  • Drive cross-team: Work closely with Product and Engineering to relay bugs, prioritize feature requests, and influence product roadmap

  • Become a product expert: Develop deep expertise in using DualEntry and translate real accounting requirements into system configurations

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 4+ years of experience in ERP, accounting audit, accounting or finance solutions. Strong preference for candidates with experience in an in-house or public accounting role

  • ERP Implementation, finance professional services or project management experience

  • Experience using or implementing ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, Intacct)

  • Proven ability to translate accounting requirements into system configurations and automated workflows

  • Strong technical aptitude (incl. SQL) and ability to quickly learn new software platforms

  • Expert Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets skills

  • Bonus: Professional services / consulting/ account management experience

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the CX Team

  • Natalee took a customer live in 3 weeks, created an onboarding implementation playbook driving best practices and milestones, which standardized our project methodology

  • Nathan inherited 4 complex implementations in his first month, took 2 of them live (put a detailed plan together for the other two), and used Claude to build an internal implementation tracker

  • Petro personally manages 20 customers (and growing), he is an SME in complex tax situations and our customers have praised him as a “true gentleman”!

     

Benefits & Compensation

  • Equity: $35,000 - $50,000

  • Base Salary: $140,000 - $190,000

  • Commission: $15,000 - $35,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

 

“I joined DualEntry to help redefine an industry that hasn't changed in thirty years. My work sits at the intersection of accounting, finance, data, technology, AI, and customer support. It's demanding, but every customer that goes live is a finance team closing their books faster than they ever have, which makes it all worth it.”

Nathan Kim, CPA - Implementations Lead at DualEntry

About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies - Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

As our Lead Analytics & Data Engineer you’ll drive both data infrastructure and data insights across product, engineering, GTM and marketing from the ground up. This is an intense, hands-on data engineering role with full ownership across all DualEntry teams. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

This is an intense, hands-on Engineer role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

📍 Location: New York City HQ, 7 World Trade Center

Where you'll create impact

  • You have maximum drive to stand up a Data & Analytics function from the ground up. You’ll work with different leaders and pods to create the right KPIs and insights across the entire team.

  • Full stack analytics engineering development, building models to consume, transform, and expose data internally and externally

  • Work with closely with different teams to capture, move, store, and transform raw data into highly actionable insights

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, data and design teams to develop prioritized product roadmaps and measure success

  • Follow through to turn those insights into action

  • Set up data processes, tools, and systems that will allow us to make better decisions in a scalable way

  • Drive a culture of experimental design, testing agenda and best practices with maximum pace, ownership and follow-through

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Math, Economics, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields with a minimum of 5 years of industry experience as a Data Scientist

  • Hands-on experience with the modern data stack (Fivetran / Snowflake / dbt / Looker / Hex / Hightouch or equivalents)

  • Hands-on experience with data orchestration platforms (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (preferably Retool, Looker, Mode, Tableau or equivalent) and experience distributing data insights via reports and dashboards

  • Strong python experience (numpy, pandas, sklearn, etc.) across exploratory data analysis, predictive modeling, and applications of ML techniques to marketing-specific problems

  • Strong knowledge of SQL (preferably Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) and how to write efficient SQL queries

  • Proven track record of shipping improvements with engineering, product and GTM organizations

  • Strong perspective on data science engineering development cycle (data modeling, version control, documentation + testing, best practices for codebase development)

  • Familiarity with B2B enterprise sales cycle metrics and processes

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly improving, start-up environment that focuses on solving problems with iterative technical solutions

  • Experience at a high-growth startup

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $44,000 - $52,000

  • Base Salary: $135,000 - $190,000

  • 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Full medical, dental & vision insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • On-site team culture - high collaboration, no bureaucracy

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Design backend systems and APIs (Python preferred) that run real-time, business-critical accounting logic

  • Ship features end to end - architecture, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and beyond

  • Integrate third-party tools and external systems, proactively managing edge cases and risk

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years in backend engineering (language agnostic)

  • Deep experience with complex business logic products

  • Strong database skills: PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, schema design

  • Experience deploying on AWS (or similar), with solid CI/CD and production-readiness fundamentals

  • Bonus: Python and a modern web framework (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the Engineering Team

  • Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

  • Marcin took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest.

  • Puhiza grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework end to end; scaling it to support migrations, integrations, and bank connections. The queen of I/O on our platform.

  • Danylo took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend.

     

How You Operate

  • Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability - we use Postgres until it breaks

  • Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three' - Jeff Bezos.

  • Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

  • Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission

     

Benefits & Compensation

  • Equity: $100,000 - $120,000

  • Base salary: $200,000 - $350,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

 

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca, Head of Engineering at DualEntry

postalAddress.streetAddress: 7 World Trade Center, 39th Floor, New York NY

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

 

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

 

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

 

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

 

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

 

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies - Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

 

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

As our Controller, you’ll own and drive DualEntry’s highest-priority company initiatives and ensure our strategy translates into measurable execution across all departments including Product, Engineering, GTM, and CX.

In addition, you’ll independently lead high-impact strategic initiatives that accelerate growth and strengthen how the company operates. You’ll also work directly with the CEO and leadership team to shape key decisions and unblock critical priorities.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

📍 Location: New York City HQ, 7 World Trade Center

 

Where you'll create impact

  • Own the full accounting function end-to-end - month-end close, reconciliations, controls and financial reporting

  • Build DualEntry's financial infrastructure from the ground up: chart of accounts, accounting policies, workflows and audit-ready controls

  • Drive GAAP-compliant reporting and own all technical accounting decisions

  • Prepare DualEntry for its first external audit and maintain ongoing audit readiness

  • Partner with the CEO, GTM and Ops to connect financial reporting to business performance ARR, burn, unit economics and board-level narratives

  • Support quarterly and annual planning: budgeting, forecasting and board reporting

  • Hire and develop a small accounting team as we scale

  • Build the financial operating model that supports our next phase of growth

 

What sets you up for success

  • 5+ years in accounting or finance, including hands-on experience at a high-growth technology company

  • CPA required

  • Deep expertise in multi-entity accounting, consolidations, and close processes

  • Strong technical accounting chops - you can navigate complex GAAP questions without outside help

  • Experience owning or leading an ERP implementation (NetSuite, Intacct, or similar)

  • High agency (you see what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be asked)

  • Obsessively organized with a bias for clean systems, clear documentation, and scalable processes

  • Strong communicator who can translate financials into business insight for non-finance stakeholders

  • Low ego, high ownership

  • Excited to work in-office 5 days/week

    Nice to have

  • Experience at a VC backed or fintech company

  • Familiarity with modern ERP and accounting infrastructure tools (Ramp, Rippling, Brex, etc.)

  • Prior experience building an accounting function from scratch or transitioning from outsourced to in-house

     

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

     

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $60,000 - $80,000

  • Base Salary: $160,000 - $200,000

  • 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Full medical, dental & vision insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • On-site team culture - high collaboration, no bureaucracy

 

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

 

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

ABOUT DUALENTRY

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

 

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

 

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

 

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

 


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS NOW



Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

 

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies - Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.



As our CFO, you'll own DualEntry's financial strategy end-to-end: planning, reporting, and the infrastructure that scales with us as we grow. You'll make sure capital is deployed intelligently and that leadership always has the financial clarity to make the right calls fast.



Beyond that, you'll lead the initiatives that matter most - revenue operations, financial systems, and the strategic decisions that shape how we compete in a $220B market. You'll work directly with the CEO on capital strategy, headcount planning, and how we tell our story to investors and the board.



We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

 

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

 

📍 Location: New York City HQ, 7 World Trade Center

 
 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Own DualEntry's financial strategy end-to-end: from daily operations to long-term capital planning

 - Build and lead the finance function as a true business partner to the CEO and leadership team

 - Manage investor relationships and own all board and investor reporting

 - Own financial planning and analysis: budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling and KPI frameworks that give leadership real-time visibility into the business

 - Lead accounting, audit and compliance - GAAP reporting, tax strategy and audit readiness at every stage

 - Work with Product and Engineering on resource allocation and headcount planning

 - Identify and evaluate strategic opportunities: partnerships, M&A and new market entry

 - Represent DualEntry to external stakeholders  investors, banks, auditors and strategic partners

 - Build and develop a world-class finance team as we scale

 - Experience as a first or early CFO at a Series A-C SaaS or fintech company

 - Prior experience in the accounting, ERP, or fintech space

WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - 8+ years in finance, with meaningful time at a high-growth technology company

 - CPA or MBA preferred

 - Proven experience leading a fundraise - you've been in the room with VCs and know how to tell a compelling financial story

 - Deep expertise in SaaS metrics, revenue recognition and multi-entity financial operations

 - Exceptional communicator who can translate complex financials into clear narratives for boards, investors, and the full company

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

Why This Role Matters Now

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Define how DualEntry shows up in the world. You’ll make decisions that shape perception with CFOs, operators and finance teams: an audience that notices when something feels cheap and responds when something feels considered

  • Lead dualentry.com as a living expression of the brand. From landing pages and feature pages to campaign moments, you’ll design with an obsessive eye for hierarchy, craft and conversion

  • Drive the creative for DualEntry’s events presence: CFO dinners, conference booths, sponsored activations. You’ll ensure every physical touchpoint feels as intentional as the digital ones

  • Build scalable systems, not one-off assets. Deck masters, social frameworks, email layouts, print templates: you’ll create the infrastructure that lets brand quality compound over time

  • Partner directly with PMM, Marketing, and Sales as a creative strategist. You know how to receive a brief, challenge it when it’s wrong and translate positioning into visual storytelling that lands

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 4+ years of design experience in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, a top-tier agency or both. The best candidates will have seen both environments

  • A portfolio that makes us stop scrolling. Strong work across brand identity, web, print and event or environmental design. Multidisciplinary range is essential. We’re looking for craft and conviction, not volume

  • You’ve built and evolved brand systems, not just executed within them. You understand the difference between a brand guide and a living identity

  • You have a point of view about what great B2B brand looks like, and the confidence to defend it. To a CEO, a PMM, or a vendor who wants to take the easy path

  • You operate at both strategic and executional altitude without losing quality at either end. You can define the system and then execute the asset

  • You’re fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Tools are not a bottleneck for you. Webflow experience is a plus

  • High agency. You don’t wait to be told what to do next, and you don’t need creative guardrails to do your best work

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the team

  • Jan made sure we were the ones being understood. Owned marketing messaging, positioning, and voice. Redesigned the DualEntry website in her first 90 days. Also launched a bi-coastal NYC/SF campaign covering over 100+ billboards that lifted brand visibility and awareness

  • Ana took the lead and owned the community and events at DualEntry from end to end. Thousands of attendees across 15+ events in 6 months. Dinners, roundtables, poker night and much more!

     

Benefits & Compensation

  • Equity: $50,000 - $60,000

  • Base Salary: $160,000 - $190,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k)

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

“We're not building a marketing team that follows the playbook. We're building the one people copy and study for years to come”

Jan Abaza, Founding Product Marketing Manager at DualEntry

  • Serve as DualEntry's Principal Solutions Consultant, translating complex accounting workflows into clear product solutions for CFOs and Controllers

  • Lead discovery calls to diagnose prospect pain points in close process, ERP limitations, and integration requirements

  • Run product demos tailored to each prospect’s workflows, data, and success criteria (expertise in ASC 606 is a plus)

  • Own technical objections across integrations, data migration, security, and reporting

  • Build proof-of-concepts and demo environments for different verticals

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize the roadmap with customer insights

  • Create and standardize demo assets, playbooks, and technical collateral to train future hires

     

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Exceptional accounting foundation: you’ve worked in audit/public accounting and/or in-house finance at a tech or high-growth company

  • You understand accounting ops end-to-end: close, journal entries, approvals, reconciliations, multi-entity, reporting, controls, etc.

  • Depth in multiple complex accounting areas (e.g., revenue recognition, inventory, FX, leases, consolidation)

  • You’ve spent time in the CFO systems stack (ERP, billing, payroll, banking, AP/AR, FP&A, BI) and you can map workflows across tools

  • Comfortable in technical conversations: integrations, APIs, data imports/migrations, security, architecture trade-offs (SQL or data/ETL experience is a plus)

  • 2+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting or an adjacent customer facing role

Nice To Have

  • CPA

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Workday, QuickBooks Enterprise migrations

  • Familiarity with data transformation, ETL, modeling, SQL

  • Experience designing API integrations or working with middleware tools

  • Prior leadership / mentorship experience building Solutions or Implementation teams

     

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the Sales Team

  • David Ryan has closed 160% of his quota in his first quarter and got promoted to a Sales Manager

  • Sam Bush closed his first deal in 28 days since his start date

  • Wyatt Myers has been building our West Coast presence by organizing events for finance leaders, most recently a poker night that turned attendees into channel partners and warm intros

  • Andy Head of Product - under his leadership the team shipped 29 projects, 325+ features in a single cycle, rebuilt bank connections and reporting infrastructure, and launched an AI accounting copilot. Kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, walking the company through how we think about building AI-native workflows

Benefits & Compensation

  • Base Salary: £100,000 – £170,000 GBP

  • OTE: £30,000 – £50,000 GBP

  • Equity: £40,000 - £70,000 GBP

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility support (Carrot)

  • Group life insurance (Allianz)

  • Workplace pension through Penfold (with salary sacrifice option)

  • Flexible PTO (28 days, including public holidays)

  • Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

  • Unlimited AI token usage

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years' tenure)

  • In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus and more!)

     

“Join now if you want to lock in, do the work and have the most rewarding role of your career!”

David Ryan, Sales Manager at DualEntry

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

Why This Role Matters Now

 

Where you'll create impact

  • Set the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for a major product area and create the clarity that other PMs and teams execute against

  • Drive ambiguous, high-impact bets from first principles, from problem framing through launch and iteration

  • Define the metrics and customer signals that demonstrate outcomes, and hold the area accountable to measurable business results (e.g., retention, activation, expansion)

  • Act as the voice of the customer in company-level strategic decisions, and translate complex accounting workflows into clear, simple requirements

  • Partner closely with engineering and design leadership on architecture and technical trade-offs that span multiple teams

  • Own product reliability, accuracy, and usability as first-class outcomes across your area

  • Set the standard for product craft, mentor other PMs, and influence peers across eng, design, and GTM leadership

  • Partner with product marketing, GTM, and sales in both directions, feeding insights back into the roadmap and shaping major launches

  • Improve the internal processes, tooling, and operating model that help the whole team ship fast

 

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 8+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • A track record of owning a product area or line and driving measurable business outcomes, not just shipping features

  • High agency and strong ownership: you set direction in ambiguity and drive it without waiting to be told

  • Deep experience applying AI/ML to real product workflows, including shipping LLM-powered or agentic features to production and reasoning about evals, failure modes, and trade-offs

  • A clear, direct communicator who creates alignment across multiple teams and senior stakeholders

  • Excited to work in person with an ambitious, fast-moving team

Nice to have

  • Hands-on building with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI) and daily use of AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, Cursor)

  • Accounting, ERP, or fintech domain experience

  • An MBA and/or experience working with business stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Revenue)

  • Technical background (CS, engineering)

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the team

  • Andy, Head of Product - under his leadership the team increased the customer win rate by focusing on the SaaS vertical, shipped the first comprehensive ERP documentation website, focused in on quality as our number one feature, and much more. Andy kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, helping accounting professionals learn about in-production AI-native workflows.

  • Cheryl, CPA demoed the product to a skeptical prospect who said our RevRec beat several standalone tools, and built the AI process now used as our "Deal Bot."

  • Charlotte, founding PM and ACA-qualified accountant the go-to on integrations, from CRM syncs to global bank connections.

  • Justin, former Consulting CFO - helped build our accounting engine from scratch and just shipped AI Flux Analysis!

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $70,000 - $80,000

  • Base salary: $220,000 - $280,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

     

“Every Product Manager here owns a real customer journey end to end, not a backlog someone handed them, that's rare, and it's why we ship faster than anywhere I've worked before!”

Andy Woods, Head of Product at DualEntry

  • Own the full release pipeline with Expo + EAS, including store submissions and provisioning

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years mobile development experience, ideally at a high-growth startup

  • Track record building smooth, high-performance apps - animations included

  • Unit testing and end-to-end QA experience

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca, Head of Engineering at DualEntry

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Own e2e account management outcomes: Manage key customer relationships, run success plans, and lead recurring check-ins, based on customer tiers you’ve developed

 - Own ERP adoption & expansion: Deliver and systemize trainings, optimize customer workflows (especially month-end close), and drive upsell/cross-sell opportunities

 - Be the ultimate escalation point: Resolve critical issues for high-tier accounts post-go-live

 - Operationalize customer support: Create and continuously improve SOPs, best practices, support documentation center, and overall support processes, while handling support for your owned accounts

 - Build and lead a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers, setting them up for success

 - Drive cross-team: Work closely with Product and Engineering to relay bugs, prioritize feature requests, and influence product roadmap

 - Become a product expert: Develop deep expertise in using DualEntry and translate real accounting requirements into system configurations

 


WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - Hardcore work ethic and high agency

 - 8+ years of Customer Success leadership, ideally in fast-paced, high-intensity settings

 - You've built a world-class CS org before, and you know what great looks like

 - Strong technical aptitude (incl. SQL) and ability to quickly learn new software platforms

 - Expert Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets skills

 - Bonus: Experience in ERP, accounting, accounting audit, finance solutions or professional services.

 


WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

 - You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

 - Your feedback shapes the product directly

 - High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations
   
    


MEET THE CX TEAM

 - Natalee https://www.linkedin.com/in/natalee-cynkar/ took a customer live in 3 weeks, created an onboarding  implementation playbook driving best practices and milestones, which standardized our project methodology

 - Nathan https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathan-kim-cpa-033266230/ inherited 4 complex implementations in his first month, took 2 of them live (put a detailed plan together for the other two), and used Claude to build an internal implementation tracker

 - Petro https://www.linkedin.com/in/petro-hanna-cpa-a41812101/?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Ad_flagship3_profile_view_base%3BYa82cyyeTMaNEJnHPR9xfg%3D%3D personally manages 20 customers (and growing), he is an SME in complex tax situations and our customers have praised him as a “true gentleman”!
   
    


BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

 - Equity: $35,000 - $50,000

 - Base Salary: $180,000 - $260,000

 - Commission: $15,000 - $45,000

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - One Medical membership

 - Mental health support (Talkspace)

 - Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

 - Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

 - 401(k) benefits

 - Commuter benefits

 - Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

 - Unlimited AI tokens

 - AI skills development & enablement

 - Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

 - Relocation support for employees moving to New York

 - Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

 - Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

 - Snacks, drinks, team events & more

 

“I joined DualEntry to help redefine an industry that hasn't changed in thirty years. My work sits at the intersection of accounting, finance, data, technology, AI, and customer support. It's demanding, but every customer that goes live is a finance team closing their books faster than they ever have, which makes it all worth it.”

Nathan Kim https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathan-kim-cpa-033266230/, CPA - Implementations Lead at DualEntry

  • Working with Sales to convert PE/VC-sourced portco intros into closed-won

  • Building collateral that speaks to fund LPs, GPs, and Operating Partners; not just end-users

  • Managing partner agreements from strawman to signature, balancing structural fairness with commercial outcomes

What sets you up for success

  • 3 to 6 years in capital markets, PE/VC, portfolio operations, or B2B partnerships that included fund or portfolio work

  • Understanding of how PE value-creation teams and VC platform teams operate

  • Ability to build the fund-level economic case, not just the portco product pitch

  • Comfort operating at the GP / Operating Partner level and translating that into portco-level activation

  • Strong commercial judgment on multi-portco deal structures

  • Data-driven and experimental mindset

Nice to have:

  • Existing network across PE Operating Partners, VC Platform teams, or the investor community

  • Prior experience selling into or partnering with PE portfolios or VC-backed cohorts

  • Fintech, ERP, or office-of-the-CFO ecosystem experience

  • Experience at an early-stage (Seed to Series B) company

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

 

Meet the Partnerships Team

  • Caelahn joined DualEntry to build the partnerships function from zero; inherited 323 partner conversations, defined our 4-channel taxonomy, and stood up the attribution and program infrastructure to activate and scale across all four channels in his first 8 weeks. He's now launching Technology, Advisory, Resellers, and Private Equity in parallel.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $40,000 - $65,000

  • Base Salary: $120,000 - $200,000

  • Commission: $30,000 - $60,000 (uncapped)

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k)

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle: prospecting through close, on complex deals multiple economic buyers

  • Multi-thread every opportunity: build relationships across finance, IT, security, and executive sponsors

  • Run deals with MEDDPICC or an equivalent framework

  • Manage internal teams through complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes

  • Navigate procurement, security reviews, and legal negotiations to close

  • Partner with BDRs to develop and prioritize enterprise pipeline

  • Identify target personas within top accounts and customize outreach to build pipeline

  • Build the playbook: talk tracks, battlecards, and the deal patterns others on the team will run

  • Own forecasting and pipeline accuracy for your book of business

  • Have real influence on GTM strategy and the product roadmap, working directly with founders

     

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 7+ years in sales, with 5+ years as an individual contributor closing enterprise deals ($100K+ ACV, multi-stakeholder, 6+ month cycles)

  • Fluency in a formal sales methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Command of the Message, or similar) and a track record of applying it to win complex deals

  • Experience selling into finance, accounting, or ERP buyers a plus

  • You have sold at early-stage startups, building process rather than inheriting it

  • Open to non-traditional backgrounds with finance or accounting experience

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to take radical ownership over deals and process

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations


Meet the Sales Team

  • Sam Bush closed his first deal 28 days after his start date

  • Andy Woods, Head of Product: under his leadership the team shipped 29 projects and 325+ features in a single cycle, rebuilt bank connections and reporting infrastructure, and launched an AI accounting copilot. Kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, walking the company through how we think about building AI-native workflows.

  • David Ryan closed 160% of his quota in his first quarter and was promoted to Sales Manager

     

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $40,000 - $55,000

  • Base Salary: $150,000 - $200,000

  • Commission: $150,000 - $200,000 (uncapped)

  • OTE: $300,000 - $400,000

  • Full medical, dental & vision insurance coverage

  • One Medical annual membership

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning

  • Unlimited AI token usage

  • AI skills development and enablement

  • Visa and permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for those moving to NY for DualEntry

  • On-site team culture - high collaboration, no bureaucracy

  • In-office perks: snacks, drinks, team events and more

 

"Join now if you want to to lock in, do the work and have the most rewarding role of your career!"

— David Ryan, Sales Manager at DualEntry

  • Run a fast, disciplined experimentation cadence

  • Drive activation and conversion improvements across the product

  • Stay close to prospects and join lost-deal calls to understand where evaluations stall

What Sets You Up for Success

  • 5–7 years across product management and growth marketing, including ownership of a B2B SaaS signup or trial funnel

  • Strong in funnel analysis, conversion optimization, positioning, and landing page copy

  • Technically fluent enough to work closely with engineers, query data, and set up tracking

  • Hands-on with product analytics, experimentation tools, CMS/page builders, and CRM systems such as HubSpot

  • Experience with product-led sales and multi-stakeholder B2B buying journeys

  • Strong judgment on when to experiment versus simply ship

  • Interest in building for accountants and finance teams

  • Accounting, ERP, compliance-heavy SaaS, or early-stage growth experience is a plus

  • MBA is a plus

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the Team

  • Andy, Head of Product - under his leadership the team increased the customer win rate by focusing on the SaaS vertical, shipped the first comprehensive ERP documentation website, focused in on quality as our number one feature, and much more. Andy kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, helping accounting professionals learn about in-production AI-native workflows.

  • Cheryl, CPA demoed the product to a skeptical prospect who said our RevRec beat several standalone tools, and built the AI process now used as our "Deal Bot."

  • Base salary: $220,000-280,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Embed on named customer projects and own them end to end: discovery, design, build, deploy and verify

  • Build migration and integration pipelines on Temporal that are idempotent, resumable, and auditable

  • Model and load customer accounting data into Postgres correctly, including reconciling against their existing system

  • Build internal tooling so recurring one-offs stop being one-offs

  • Feed patterns back into the core product, and productize or hand off anything that becomes permanent

  • Compress the path from “customer requested” to “shipped"

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years shipping production full stack software, end to end and unsupervised

  • Django and DRF, plus Postgres beyond ORM defaults. You read query plans and you have run migrations against live data with customers on it

  • Next.js and React with TypeScript

  • Durable workflow experience. Temporal preferred but Celery is fine

  • Direct customer exposure on past experiences. You have sat with a customer, scoped the problem with them, and shipped against it

  • Experience with third party APIs, webhooks, rate limits, reconciling two systems that disagree

Nice to Have

  • Accounting, ERP, or fintech domain knowledge: double-entry, chart of accounts, close, AP/AR, revenue recognition

  • Prior forward deployed, applied, or special projects experience

  • Judgment about when to ship a script versus build a system

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

 

Meet the Team

  • Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself

  • Marcin took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest

  • Puhiza grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework. The queen of I/O on our platform

  • Danylo took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $60,000 - $80,000

  • Base salary: $160,000 - $270,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more!

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca, Head of Engineering at DualEntry

About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Recruit, onboard, coach and develop a high-performing UK BDR team

  • Own the day-to-day performance of the BDR function, setting clear expectations around activity, qualified meetings, pipeline generation and conversion

  • Build a strong outbound culture centered around quality, accountability, consistency and continuous improvement

  • Run regular 1:1s, call coaching, team meetings, performance reviews and development conversations

  • Use activity, conversion and pipeline data to identify performance gaps and improve results across the funnel

  • Work closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, coordinate outbound activity and maintain high-quality opportunity handovers

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Proven experience managing BDRs or SDRs within a B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Strong understanding of modern outbound prospecting, particularly cold calling, email, LinkedIn and account-based approaches

  • Previous success in an individual pipeline-generation or closing sales role, giving you first-hand understanding of what strong prospecting looks like

  • Strong coaching skills with the ability to identify why someone is underperforming and turn that diagnosis into practical improvement

  • Experience building or improving sales processes, messaging, sequences, qualification frameworks or outbound playbooks

  • High expectations of yourself and your team, combined with the ability to coach people constructively and help them improve

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Nice to have

  • Experience selling ERP, accounting software, fintech, financial management software or another complex business application

  • Experience prospecting into CFOs, Finance Directors, Financial Controllers or other senior finance stakeholders

  • Experience helping build or scale a new market, territory or sales development function.

  • Experience working within an early-stage or high-growth US SaaS company expanding internationally

 

Meet the Team

  • David Ryan has closed 160% of his quota in his first quarter and got promoted to a Sales Manager

  • Sam Bush closed his first deal in 28 days since his start date

  • Wyatt Myers has been building our West Coast presence by organizing events for finance leaders, most recently a poker night that turned attendees into channel partners and warm intros

 
 
 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: £40,000 - £55,000

  • OTE: £100,000 - £130,000

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility support (Carrot)

  • Group life insurance (Allianz)

  • Workplace pension through Penfold (with salary sacrifice option)

  • Flexible PTO (28 days, including public holidays)

  • Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

  • Unlimited AI token usage

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years' tenure)

  • In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus and more!)

Where you'll create impact

  • Set the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for a major product area and create the clarity that other PMs and teams execute against

  • Own complex technical areas end to end: agents, ML, and the LLM-vs-deterministic trade-off

  • Work out how we ingest data from dozens of systems, keep it synchronized, and create bi-directional workflows

  • Build the evals system that makes reliability and accuracy first-class outcomes - your agents post to a real ledger

  • Drive ambiguous, high-impact bets from first principles, from problem framing through launch and iteration

  • Hold the area accountable to measurable business results (retention, activation, expansion), not just shipped features

  • Partner closely with engineering and design leadership on architecture and technical trade-offs that span multiple teams

  • Improve the internal processes, tooling, and operating model that help the whole team ship fast

 

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 8+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • A track record of owning a product area or line and driving measurable business outcomes, not just shipping features

  • High agency and strong ownership: you set direction in ambiguity and drive it without waiting to be told

  • Deep experience applying AI/ML to real product workflows, including shipping LLM-powered or agentic features to production and reasoning about evals, failure modes, and trade-offs

  • A clear, direct communicator who creates alignment across multiple teams and senior stakeholders

  • Excited to work in person with an ambitious, fast-moving team

Nice to have

  • Hands-on building with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI) and daily use of AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, Cursor)

  • Accounting, ERP, or fintech domain experience

  • An MBA and/or experience working with business stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Revenue)

  • Technical background (CS, engineering)

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

  • Andy, Head of Product - under his leadership the team increased the customer win rate by focusing on the SaaS vertical, shipped the first comprehensive ERP documentation website, focused in on quality as our number one feature, and much more. Andy kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, helping accounting professionals learn about in-production AI-native workflows.

  • Cheryl, CPA demoed the product to a skeptical prospect who said our RevRec beat several standalone tools, and built the AI process now used as our "Deal Bot."

  • Charlotte, founding PM and ACA-qualified accountant the go-to on integrations, from CRM syncs to global bank connections.

  • Justin, former Consulting CFO - helped build our accounting engine from scratch and just shipped AI Flux Analysis!

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity: $70,000 - $80,000

  • Base salary: $220,000 - $280,000

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

     

“Every Product Manager here owns a real customer journey end to end, not a backlog someone handed them, that's rare, and it's why we ship faster than anywhere I've worked before!”

Andy Woods, Head of Product at DualEntry

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s, with no new entrants in 30 years. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers. We're looking for people with a track record of accomplishing difficult things, whether through their careers or achievements outside of work. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community - because that's what it takes to reinvent a $220B industry.

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Drive the full product lifecycle for a new product area, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration

  • Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for your area

  • Define the metrics and customer signals that demonstrate outcomes and drive continuous improvement across all customer personas

  • Act as the voice of the customer in strategic decisions and translate complex accounting workflows into clear, simple requirements

  • Partner closely with engineering and design day to day, navigating technical trade-offs together

  • Own product reliability, accuracy and usability as first-class outcomes

  • Partner with product marketing, GTM and sales in both directions, feeding insights back into the roadmap and supporting launches

  • Improve the internal processes and tooling that help the team ship fast

 

What It Takes

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • High agency and strong ownership: you set direction and drive it without waiting to be told

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML to real product workflows, including shipping LLM-powered features to production

  • A clear, direct communicator who keeps multiple work streams organized

  • Excited to work in person with an ambitious, fast-moving team

Nice to have

  • Hands-on building with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain) and daily use of AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, Cursor)

  • Accounting, ERP, or fintech domain experience

  • An MBA and/or experience working with business stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Revenue)

  • Technical background (CS, engineering)

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

     

Meet the Team

  • Max owns the automation and productization of our GTM motion. In his first quarter, he created a systems for customers to "try before they buy" - leading to a 2x+ boost in win-rate, as well as spinning up dozens of bots and agents to build cross-functional efficiency.

  • Woosung leads finance at DualEntry and will work closely with the you on the special projects.

     

Benefits & Compensation

  • Tailored equity ownership package

  • Base Compensation: $200,000+

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance

  • One Medical membership

  • Mental health support (Talkspace)

  • Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

  • Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

  • 401(k) benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

  • Unlimited AI tokens

  • AI skills development & enablement

  • Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

  • Relocation support for employees moving to New York

  • Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

  • Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

  • Snacks, drinks, team events & more

 

“This role sits at the center of everything, driving DualEntry’s highest-priority company initiatives. If you want a front-row seat to how a company actually gets built, this is it.”

Woosung Chun, CFO at DualEntry
